messages:
tara-peopleops: Heads up 1: Ryan flagged an approved band move for Aisha (L3->L4) effective 2026-05-01. Ryan asked whether we should put the comp into the 5/1 run or do retro to 5/1 on the 5/15 payroll.
ryan-engmgr: Goal is to keep offer comps consistent for our new hires next week. If retro is possible that'd be ideal. What's the fastest route?
aisha-ic: Also tagging on equity/benefits: if the effective date is 5/1 will my benefits eligibility or bonus target change immediately?
maria-peopleops: Short answer: comp can be retro'd, but we need paperwork and payroll windows. Benefits eligibility generally changes on the plan effective date (often the 1st of the month) but some enrollments are subject to open-enroll rules or specific carrier timelines. Bonus targets update immediately once comp is in the system.
ryan-engmgr: Paperwork = manager approval + compensation form + calibration note, right?
maria-peopleops: Correct. For retro to 2026-05-01 we need: 1) signed manager+director approvals, 2) completed compensation change form in Workday marked "retro", 3) attach calibration note or leveling rubric excerpt, 4) email hr-escalations and cc payroll.
payroll-bot: Payroll reminder: standard cutoff to affect the mid-month run is the 10th. However, due to a vendor holiday in May the cutoff for the 2026-05-15 run is 2026-05-08. Changes submitted after that will process on 2026-06-15.
aisha-ic: I'm based in the UK 1: does currency conversion or taxes change the timeline for retro?
maria-peopleops: International folks: payroll ops does local currency conversion during processing and the effective pay date is still the payroll run date. Retro will be applied in local currency at the run conversion rate; taxes and statutory withholdings are computed per local rules and may require separate filings. This sometimes adds an extra review step, so aim to submit earlier.
ryan-engmgr: What about contractors or new hires still in onboarding? One of mine hasn't finished verification and moves orgs on 5/01.
aisha-ic: (correction) Ryan meant the contractor is moving teams, not me.
maria-peopleops: If the person is a contingent worker we need a separate contractor comp change flow; those often can't be retro'd into payroll and require AP journal adjustments. For headcount transfers with incomplete onboarding, confirm employment status before requesting retro.
ryan-engmgr: Is there any change to stock vesting or grant eligibility when someone moves bands?
tara-peopleops: Level change doesn't auto-create a grant. If comp package includes an equity refresh we issue a separate grant with its own grant date. Existing grants keep their vesting schedule unless a new grant is issued and signed.
aisha-ic: If retro pays me for 5/1-5/14 will benefits like health plan premiums be adjusted?
maria-peopleops: Premiums: we reconcile benefits deductions after pay runs. Retro pay may increase gross pay for the retro period; payroll will adjust deductions accordingly. For any manual carrier reporting (rare) payroll will notify benefits ops.
payroll-bot: Docs checklist: attach PDFs only. For international employees include a scanned passport + local tax ID if available. Non-PDF attachments delay processing.
ryan-engmgr: OK timeline I'm aiming to gather approvals and file by 2026-05-06 to be safe.
maria-peopleops: Good plan. Quick sample note to paste into Workday change form: "Approved level change L3->L4 effective 2026-05-01. Retro pay requested for 2026-05-01 through 2026-05-14. Attach: manager approval, calibration note. Payroll: please attempt processing in 2026-05-15 run (cutoff 2026-05-08); if not possible, process on 2026-06-15 and notify manager"
aisha-ic: Thanks everyone 1: appreciate the clarity.
payroll-bot: Final reminder: if this crosses cost centers, both receiving and sending managers must approve the Workday transaction.
